mapper.update: UPDATE point_application SET status=#{status},reviewer_user_id=#{reviewerUserId},review_note=#{reviewNote},awarded_points=#{awardedPoints},grant_ledger_id=#{grantLedgerId},reviewed_at=#{reviewedAt},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND revision=#{revision}

UPDATE point_application SET status='CLOSED',closed_at=#{closedAt},closed_by_user_id=#{closedByUserId},closure_reason=#{closureReason},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND revision=#{revision}
